itineraries.description: Two days at the heart of Ha Long Bay: kayak through Luon Cave, climb Ti Top Island for the panorama, spend the evening aboard with a cooking class and squid fishing, then visit Sung Sot Cave the next morning.
itineraries.name: The Halong Escape - 2 Days 1 Night

itineraries.description: One more day to go deeper: on day two a private day boat takes you to Cua Van floating village, the archaeological Tien Ong Cave and a pearl farm, quieter corners of the bay the two-day voyage doesn't reach.
itineraries.name: The Halong Immersion - 3 Days 2 Nights
